title: Graphic Designer & Video Editor
description:
**Job Title:** Graphic Designer cum Videographer cum Video Editor  
**Location:** Noida  
**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience Level:** Senior

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a talented and creative **Graphic Designer cum Videographer cum Video Editor** to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in designing stunning visual content, shooting high\-quality videos, and editing engaging multimedia content for various platforms. This role is perfect for someone with a keen eye for aesthetics, a passion for storytelling, and technical proficiency in design and video production.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conceptualize and design engaging graphics for digital and print media, including social media, marketing materials, websites, advertisements, and branding assets.
* Plan, shoot, and edit high\-quality video content for social media, advertisements, corporate videos, and promotional campaigns.
* Work with the marketing and content team to create visually compelling content that aligns with brand guidelines.
* Develop motion graphics, animations, and visual effects to enhance video content.
* Edit raw footage, add music, voiceovers, and special effects to create polished, professional\-quality videos.
* Ensure consistency and brand identity across all visual and video content.
* Stay updated with industry trends, design and video editing software, and best practices to enhance content quality.
* Manage and organize media assets, ensuring accessibility and proper archiving.
* Collaborate with clients, marketing teams, and other stakeholders to deliver creative solutions.
* Handle photography assignments as needed to support content creation.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications:**

* Proven experience as a **Graphic Designer, Videographer, and Video Editor** with a strong portfolio.
* Proficiency in **Adobe Creative Suite** (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects, Lightroom, Corel Draw) and other design/video editing tools.
* Strong knowledge of video production techniques, including shooting, lighting, and sound recording.
* Experience in creating motion graphics and animations.
* Familiarity with DSLR cameras, professional video equipment, and lighting setups.
* Strong understanding of composition, typography, and color theory.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Creativity and attention to detail.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience in photography and photo \& video editing.
* Knowledge of UI/UX design principles.
* Experience with social media marketing and content strategy.

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

Education:

* Diploma (Preferred)

Experience:

* Graphic design: 2 years (Required)
* Video editing: 1 year (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

title: Senior User Exp Design Engineer I
description:
Position Overview:

This is more than a job. It’s a chance to build, grow, and make a real impact! Join our team as our new **Design Analyst \- User Experience (UX) !**

  

The position requires a strong expertise on User Experience(UX) design for enterprise applications, utilising UX best practices, Design System, requirement comprehension and an understanding of User Interface(UI) to build great products. You will work closely with a team of Product Managers, Technical Architects, Product Designers and Front\-end Developers focused on delivering world\-class user\-centered experiences. While collaborating with key engineering and business partners, you will define and drive exceptional design deliverables across products and initiatives.* Location: Noida
* Hybrid


Responsibilities:
* Implement and continuously improve product design practices and deliverables for products
* Implement design guidelines to meet overall Design standards.
* Work in a highly collaborative fashion with other designers, product managers, product marketing, product owners, and other key stakeholders to ensure deliverables are aligned with product release scope
* Ensure the team sets a high\-quality bar for their work while establishing the trade off with meeting delivery timescale.
* Contribute to complex layers e.g. patterns and templates of our mature atomic design system while remaining brand aligned and consistent, and ensuring we can deliver at pace.
* Participate in design reviews and share your work regularly with key stakeholders in design, product management, marketing, engineering
* Build a longer term vision for SBS products and their interconnections, maintaining a strategic approach to design


Qualifications:
**We’re interested in hearing from you, if*** You are a strong UX practitioner, with expertise on Figma
* You’ve designed for world\-class enterprise applications before—preferably in the financial services space.
* You have strong experience in stakeholder management, esp. working with engineers and product managers to deliver efficiently.
* You have experience designing and delivering complex products.
* You have experience balancing creative / analytical design goals and making product and design trade\-offs.
* You have an ability to thrive and effectively communicate with multiple senior stakeholders in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.
* You have worked with design systems and their use in a product delivery environment.
* You can balance short term and medium term goals with design tradeoffs
* You have a design\-related degree or ability to show how other degree relates to this role.
* You are fluent in English


Company Overview:

At SBS, we’re more than just a technology company – we’re a global fintech partner helping banks and financial institutions transform, innovate, and grow. With over 5,000 employees worldwide and clients in more than 80 countries, our solutions power everything from digital banking and lending to payments and core banking systems.  

As part of 74Software, we’re backed by a group of leading software companies delivering mission\-critical solutions worldwide. Our focus is on delivering long\-term value, leveraging cutting\-edge technology, and fostering strong client partnerships. Join us and be part of a collaborative, forward\-thinking team shaping the future of finance.**Equal Opportunity Employer**
------------------------------


At our organization, we are committed to fighting against all forms of discrimination. We foster a work environment that is inclusive and respectful of all differences.
All of our positions are open to people with disabilities.

title: UI/UX Designer
description:
Experience: 3–4 Years

Location: Noida

Working Days \- 6

Employment Type: Full\-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented UI/UX Designer with 2–4 years of professional experience to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a strong eye for design, a deep understanding of UI/UX principles, and hands\-on experience designing modern, intuitive, and user\-friendly digital products using Figma.

You will work closely with product managers, developers, and stakeholders to design engaging user experiences for websites, mobile applications, dashboards, and other digital products.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design clean, modern, and user\-friendly interfaces using Figma.
* Create wireframes, user flows, customer journeys, prototypes, and high\-fidelity UI designs.
* Design responsive websites, landing pages, mobile applications, dashboards, and web applications.
* Develop and maintain reusable design systems, components, and style guides.
* Ensure consistency in typography, colors, spacing, and overall visual design.
* Collaborate closely with developers to ensure pixel\-perfect implementation.
* Conduct competitor analysis and contribute to improving user experience.
* Iterate and improve designs based on feedback, usability testing, and business requirements.
* Organize and maintain Figma files, libraries, and components.
* Stay updated with the latest UI/UX trends, tools, and best practices.

**Required Skills \& Qualifications**

* 3–4 years of experience as a UI/UX Designer or Product Designer.
* Strong proficiency in Figma.
* Excellent understanding of UI/UX principles, responsive design, and accessibility.
* Experience creating wireframes, prototypes, and interactive user flows.
* Strong knowledge of design systems and reusable components.
* Good understanding of typography, color theory, spacing, and visual hierarchy.
* Experience collaborating with developers and cross\-functional teams.
* Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS is a plus.
* Experience with Adobe Photoshop, Adobe Illustrator, and FigJam is preferred.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and time management skills.

**Portfolio Requirement**

Candidates must share their portfolio along with their application.

**The portfolio should demonstrate:**

* Websites, mobile apps, dashboards, or SaaS products
* Wireframes and prototypes
* High\-fidelity UI designs
* Design systems or component libraries (preferred)

**Applications without a relevant portfolio will not be considered.**

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on exciting real\-world digital products.
* Collaborate with a talented and supportive team.
* Opportunity to learn, grow, and take ownership of design decisions.
* Exposure to end\-to\-end product design and development.

**How to Apply**

**Email: hr@rahaneaitech.com**

Pay: ₹35,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in UI/UX Design?
* Which design tools are you proficient in? (Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator, CorelDRAW, etc.)
* Please share your portfolio link or previous design work.
* Do you have experience designing websites, web applications, or mobile applications?
* Please mention your current salary \-
* Expected salary

description:

About the Role

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Website Designer with Blog Writing

expertise to manage and improve our website’s design, user experience, and content. The

ideal candidate should have a good understanding of website design, SEO\-friendly content

writing, and digital marketing.

Key Responsibilities

 Design, update, and maintain website pages, landing pages, and promotional

sections.

 Create user\-friendly, visually appealing, and mobile\-responsive website layouts.

 Write engaging, informative, and SEO\-friendly blogs related to medical education

and exam preparation.

 Conduct keyword research and optimise blogs for search engine rankings.

 Create website content, including headlines, descriptions, banners, FAQs, and course

pages.

 Coordinate with the marketing, academic, and technical teams for website updates.

performance.

 Ensure all website content follows the brand’s tone and communication style.

or a related field.
